text: U.S. stock indices traded with volatility on July 31, 2026, as the market reacted to a divergence in major technology earnings. While the broader market attempted to maintain momentum, the technology sector saw mixed performance, with Amazon shares surging on strong cloud and AI-driven results, while Apple shares declined following a weaker-than-expected sales outlook. Additionally, rising U.S. Treasury yields—with the 10-year note reaching its highest level since January 2025—added pressure to equity valuations throughout the session.
